stats.statsView.agentWorkHint: How long agents spent on replies: the sum of turn durations. Parallel sessions add up, so there can be more hours than in a day.
stats.statsView.apiCostHint: What these tokens would cost at the public Anthropic and OpenAI API prices. We work on a subscription and don't pay this: it's a measure of load, not a bill.
stats.statsView.cacheHint: The higher, the less context the model rereads from scratch.
stats.statsView.cacheHitHint: Share of input read from the prompt cache: cache reads / (new input + cache writes + cache reads). It drops when the context resets: a model switch, pauses longer than the cache lives, compaction. The change is in percentage points.
stats.statsView.calendarHint: Prompts per day over the last year, whatever period is selected. The shade is a quartile: the darker, the more prompts that day compared with the other days.
stats.statsView.costHint: Tokens multiplied by the public model prices, including cache write and read prices. By model: the five most expensive are shown separately, the rest are folded into "Other".
stats.statsView.errorNoAccess: You don't have access to statistics
stats.statsView.errorsHint: Share of tool calls that returned an error. Interrupts: how many times a person stopped the agent. Denials: how many times they refused an action. The change is in percentage points.
stats.statsView.errorsPanelHint: A spike usually means a broken environment: no access, a service down, the wrong directory.
stats.statsView.errorsSub: Share of calls with an error per day
stats.statsView.firstPass: The first pass over the history is still running: {machines}. The numbers will fill in on their own.
stats.statsView.hoursByDay: Hours spent on replies per day, {period}
stats.statsView.hoursHint: The sum of agent turn durations. Parallel sessions add up.
stats.statsView.noComparison: The comparison with the previous period appears once the history is longer than the selected period: right now it starts later than the previous period.
stats.statsView.noTasks: No task keys appeared in sessions during this period
stats.statsView.projectsHint: A project is taken from the session's working directory: the main checkout, a worktree and a directory on another machine all map to one repository.
stats.statsView.promptsHint: Messages a person wrote to an agent themselves. Service messages, notifications and subagent replies are not counted. Compared with the same number of days before.
stats.statsView.punchSub: Prompts by hour and weekday, Moscow time
stats.statsView.sessionsHint: Conversations with an agent that had a prompt or a reply in the period. Resume continues the same session. MRs are merge request links Claude Code attached to sessions.
stats.statsView.sessionsPanelHint: Other people's session titles are hidden: only the numbers are shown.
stats.statsView.subtitle: Claude Code and Codex on every team machine · days in Moscow time
stats.statsView.tasksHint: A session that mentions several tasks counts towards each of them, so the sum over tasks can exceed the total.
stats.statsView.tasksSub: Task keys from session branches and prompts
stats.statsView.teamHint: Comparison over the selected period. Cost is at API prices, see the tile hint.
stats.statsView.title: Statistics
stats.statsView.tokensHint: Input is new tokens that weren't in the cache. Cache writes and reads are context the model reuses between replies, which is why cache reads are orders of magnitude larger than the rest.
stats.statsView.unavailable: No answer from: {machines}. Their data isn't shown here.
